profit_quality.assessment: Mainland private hospital services generated strong operating cash flow in 2024-2025, but 2025 accounting profit includes non-operating disposal, financial asset and fair-value items, while the core hospital business faces patient-volume and policy pressure. Main denominator uses RMB90.0m pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit and a 0.70 profit haircut.
adjustments: Started from recent three-year parent net profit: RMB121.062m in 2023, RMB15.337m in 2024 and RMB99.591m in 2025; median is RMB99.591m.
Reduced 2025 profit for non-operating gains and income: disposal gain RMB18.940m, FVTPL fair value gain RMB8.600m, FVTPL investment income RMB6.119m and bank/other interest income RMB4.173m.

Considered add-backs/normalisation for non-cash investment property fair-value loss RMB4.500m and associate loss RMB23.158m, but did not fully neutralise credit-loss risk because ECL provision increased to RMB44.536m.
Cross-checked free cash flow after purchases of PPE and PPE deposits: RMB73.310m in 2023, RMB193.420m in 2024 and RMB234.482m in 2025.
Applied a 0.70 haircut for hospital policy pressure, lower patient visits, continuing capex needs, hemodialysis loss stage and social-insurance/receivable collection risk.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow / parent net profit was about 2.84x in 2025; 2025 operating cash flow was RMB282.664m and capex/deposit cash outflow was RMB48.182m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash flow supports profitability, but earnings are not clean enough for a near-1.0 factor because of non-operating gains, policy pressure, receivable/ECL risk and ongoing medical-facility reinvestment.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Good in recent two years on reported operating cash flow, but partly supported by operating payables/advances and should not be extrapolated at the best-year FCF level.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2025 cash capex plus PPE deposits was RMB48.182m; management discussion also cites acquired PPE and construction in progress expenditure of RMB61.3m and RMB20.3m.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables declined in 2025, but past-due receivables remained RMB62.032m and ECL provision increased, so a normal reinvestment/collection haircut remains necessary.
